newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London gain on dollar strength.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London gain on dollar strength.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London on Tuesday extended Monday's gains as high-tech shares continued to be buoyed by a firm dollar/yen exchange rate, dealers said.
Dealers said shares in Sony Corporation led the advance, surging 192.5 yen to close at 11,892.5 yen.
Shares in Toshiba Corp gained 4.5 yen to 740.5 yen while Hitachi rose 8.5 yen to 1,328.5 yen and NEC Corporation climbed 10 yen to 1,680 yen.
Dealers said trading in other sectors was quiet with the exception of pharmaceuticals where shares in Eisai Co Ltd suffered from profit-taking and fell 15 yen to 2,485.
The Nikkei/ISE index firmed 9.35 points to close at 1,720.21 after the Nikkei 225 index in Tokyo dropped 172.52 points to close at 20,402.74.
